fields.body:
## **About One Acre Fund**

Founded in 2006, One Acre Fund equips 5.5 million smallholder farmers to make their farms more productive. Across nine countries that together are home to two-thirds of Africa's farmers, we provide high-quality farm supplies, tree seedlings, accessible credit, modern agronomic training, and a wide range of other agricultural services. On average, this model enables any farmer to increase their income and assets on supported land by more than 35 percent, while permanently improving their resilience. This is all made possible by our team of 9,000+ full-time staff, drawn from diverse backgrounds and professions. To learn more, please see our [Why Work Here](https://oneacrefund.org/careers/why-work-here) blog post.

Our Rwanda program, founded in 2007 is our largest and operates under the local brand Tubura. We have more than 3,000 staff across all four provinces of Rwanda, as well as in Kigali. Together, we served more than 2.8 million farmers in 2024. We work closely with the government to support national efforts to improve food security. Additionally, we help channel funding and resources to promising agri-SMEs, supporting farmers by providing a market for high-impact crops such as coffee, avocado, and chili.

## **About the Role**

To drive seamless data flow between the Back Office Portal and SAP B1 and to optimize workflows to ensure 100% data delivery to MCF within 45 days. Key role in process improvement.

## **Responsibilities**

Accounting Systems & Systems Integration

- Drive data flow management and system integration between the Back Office Portal and SAP Business One (SAP B1), troubleshooting integration errors and optimizing system workflows.

Master Data Management & Process Improvement

- Manage and update vendor master records to ensure data accuracy, completeness, and compliance with company policies and donors’ audit-required standards.

Cross-Functional Communication & Technical Translation

- Serve as the technical bridge between Tech, FRC, and FAS teams by translating complex data insights and system requirements into actionable process improvements.

Collaborative Quality Assurance

- Partner across departments to make sure that processes are fully documented, maintain spreadsheet audit standards, streamline reporting workflows, and establish organization-wide data management best practices.

## **Career Growth and Development**

We have a strong culture of constant learning and we invest in developing our people. You’ll have weekly check-ins with your manager, access to mentorship and training programs, and regular feedback on your performance. We hold career reviews every six months, and set aside time to discuss your aspirations and career goals. You’ll have the opportunity to shape a growing organization and build a rewarding long-term career.

## **Qualifications**

Across all roles, these are the [general qualifications we look for](https://oneacrefund.org/work-with-us/application-process/qualifications/). For this role specifically, you will have:

- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Finance, Business Information Systems, or a related field.
- At least 2 to 5 years of experience in data integration, master data management, or systems analysis.
- Demonstrated proficiency with ERP systems, specifically SAP Business One (SAP B1).
- Advanced Excel skills (PivotTables, XLOOKUP, logical formulas) for data manipulation and auditing.
- Proven track record in process optimization, root-cause analysis, and data error troubleshooting.
- Strong cross-functional communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical data issues into actionable solutions for non-technical stakeholders.
- Fluency in English and Kinyarwanda is required.

## **Preferred Start Date**

As soon as possible

## **Job Location**

Kigali, Rwanda

## **Benefits**

Health insurance, paid time off

## **Contract Duration**

2 years

## **Eligibility**

This role is only open to citizens or permanent residents of Rwanda.

## **Application Deadline**

03 January 2027. Please note that we hire on a rolling basis which means that applications are reviewed and processed on a continuous basis until a hire is made.

*One Acre Fund never asks candidates to pay any money or pay for tests at any stage of the interview process. Official One Acre Fund emails will always arrive from an @*[*oneacrefund.org*](http://oneacrefund.org/) *address. Please report any suspicious communication here (globalhotline@oneacrefund.org), **but do not send applications or application materials to this email address.***

*Diversity, Equity, Inclusion (DEI), and anti-racism are deeply connected to our organization’s mission and purpose. One Acre Fund aspires to build a culture where all staff feel consistently valued, represented, and connected – so that our team can thrive as professionals, and achieve exceptional impact for the farmers we serve.*

*We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.*

fields.title: Project Officer – MEAL, Ukraine (Europe and Asia)
fields.body:
At DCAF, we envision a world where democratic sector governance advances sustainable peace and development and human dignity for all.

Our mission is to advance the security of all people through nationally owned, inclusive, and participatory security sector reforms based on international norms and good practices.

DCAF contributes to making peace and development more sustainable by assisting partner states and international actors supporting these states, to improve the governance of their security sector through inclusive and participatory reforms. It creates innovative knowledge products, promotes norms and good practices, provides legal and policy advice and supports capacity‐building of both state and non‐state security sector stakeholders.

The Europe and Asia Entity at DCAF works across Eastern Europe, the South Caucasus, Central Asia and other parts of Europe and Asia, providing policy advice, capacity-building, technical assistance and support to institutional reforms. Its work covers areas such as democratic oversight, accountability, integrity and anti-corruption, human rights, defence and security governance, and institutional resilience, working closely with governments, parliaments, security institutions, civil society and international partners. For our country office in Kyiv, Ukraine, we are looking for a highly-motivated and dynamic individual to be our next **Project Officer – MEAL (Europe and Asia).**

**Location: Kyiv, Ukraine**

**Starting date: As soon as possible**

**Work rate: 100%**

**Duration: 2-year fixed-term contract \***

**The role**

The Project Officer (MEAL) provides country-level capacity for Monitoring, Evaluation, Accountability and Learning (MEAL), while supporting activity-level financial tracking, reporting and programme administration for DCAF’s Ukraine programme. The position strengthens evidence-based programme management by ensuring that implementation progress, results and expenditure are consistently tracked against approved objectives, outputs and activities.

The main objective of the position is to support the effective implementation of DCAF’s MEAL framework across the Ukraine programme, with a particular focus on results-based management and programme performance. The position contributes to ensuring that implementation progress, results and, where relevant, financial delivery are effectively monitored and used to inform programme management, reporting and adaptation. It also supports the integration of MEAL considerations across programme activities and may contribute to programme and office administration as required.

Within the team structure, the Project Officer (MEAL) provides an important link between programme performance, financial implementation and administrative follow-up, enabling management to assess whether resources, activities and results remain aligned. The position works closely with the team in Kyiv and Geneva to ensure consistency with DCAF’s corporate MEAL, financial and donor-reporting requirements. The position reports to the Fund Manager in Geneva.

**Key areas of operation**

• Maintain and coordinate the programme MEAL framework, including the results framework, indicators, monitoring tools and reporting arrangements across the Ukraine programme.

• Monitor and analyse programme performance and results, collect relevant data and identify implementation trends, challenges and areas requiring management attention.

• Coordinate beneficiary feedback, lessons learned and other accountability processes, ensuring that findings are documented and reflected in programme adaptation and development.

• Contribute to donor reporting, programme reviews and evaluations by providing accurate performance, results and financial implementation data.

• Support programme and office administration, documentation and coordination, working closely with the Head of Country Office, Resource Manager and programme team to ensure efficient day-to-day implementation.

**Your experience**

• 3 to 5 years of relevant professional experience in MEAL, programme monitoring, administration or a related field, preferably within an international organisation or donor funded programme.

• Professional proficiency in Ukrainian and English, with the ability to communicate effectively with Ukrainian partners, colleagues and international teams.

• Demonstrated experience in monitoring and evaluation, results frameworks, indicator tracking, data collection and analysis, preferably in governance, development or security sector programmes.

• Strong analytical and organisational skills, with the ability to manage data and documentation, identify implementation issues, meet deadlines and translate monitoring findings into practical recommendations.

• Ukrainian citizenship at the time of application is a prerequisite.

**We offer**

• a rewarding, dynamic and meaningful work experience

• the chance to be part of a diverse team of collaborative, respectful, hardworking and values-driven people

• the chance to contribute to advance the security of all people through nationally owned, inclusive, and participatory security sector reforms based on international norms and good practices.

• the position is offered on the basis of an official employment contract, with all applicable taxes and statutory social security contributions paid by the employer in accordance with Ukrainian legislation.

• the expected net monthly salary (after applicable taxes and employee social security contributions) is EUR 1,600–1,800, depending on qualifications and relevant experience.

*\* The post remains subject to continued project funding.*

fields.body:
**Background/IRC Summary**

The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world’s worst humanitarian crises and helps people whose lives and livelihoods are shattered by conflict and disaster to survive, recover, and gain control of their lives. Founded in 1933 at the request of Albert Einstein, the IRC works with people forced to flee from war, conflict and disaster and the host communities which support them, as well as those who remain within their homes and communities. At work today in over 40 countries and 25 U.S. cities, we improve outcomes in the areas of health, safety, economic wellbeing, education and power.

The IT department provides end-to-end technology solutions for the organization, including Application Development, Integration and Management, Enterprise Architecture, User Experience, Quality Assurance & Testing, and overall Product Management. While this role sits within IT, its focus is on partnering with the Measurement, Evaluation, Technology, Accountability, and Learning (METAL) Unit — bringing IT's systems and development expertise to METAL's technology and data priorities. The METAL Unit supports Crisis Response, Recovery & Development (CRRD) in building a culture of strong data and evidence use through stewardship of the Data & Performance Ecosystem, and coordinates the piloting and uptake of innovative technology solutions across four pillars: Global METAL Practice, Technology for Programs, Regional METAL Support, and CRRD Data & Analytics. This role is anchored in Technology for Programs which maintains the tools and systems that support program teams' data collection and use in the field.

**Job Overview/Summary**

Focused on data collection and program administration technology support, the Software Developer Analyst is a member of the team responsible for developing, implementing, and supporting IRC’s global Data Toolkits and the analysis of the data generated by these products. This includes CommCare, Microsoft Power BI, and Microsoft SQL Server Azure based data warehouse. Working in partnership with staff at various levels and locations, the Software Developer Analyst performs a key role in analyzing, developing, and improving tools and processes contributing to the successful rollout of the Data Toolkits products.

Specific tasks include data platform development, support, configuration, technical assistance and issues routing, second line help desk support, and participation in setting standards for processes, data quality, security, and systems configurations.

**Major Responsibilities**

- Design, develop, and maintain Data Toolkits in CommCare
- Design and build PowerBI Dashboards linked to live CommCare data
- Review and analyze software requirements, confirm the feasibility and complexity of these requirements, and convert them into estimated developer tasks, validating that each requirement traces cleanly to system design and existing configuration before work begins
- Provide updates and technology insights/clarifications to the relevant stakeholders
- Develop and maintain data and metadata definitions, documentation and versioning.
- Create technical documentation including system diagrams and implementation manuals
- Implement and maintain data quality processes and development standards
- Ensure compliance with IRC’s data protection, confidentiality, and security policies
- Provide Tier-2 and Tier-3 support emerging from Countries and Regional Technology support team for the measurement technology products rolled out.
- During piloting and rollout, provide training and hyper-support on measurement technology products in close collaboration with the regional technology teams.
- Any other duties as assigned by the supervisor.

## **Key Working Relationships**

- Position Reports to: Business Systems Analyst
- Direct Reports: None
- Management in Partnership: None

## **Key Internal Relationships:**

- ## CommCare Product Manager
- METAL QA Analyst
- IT Data Team

**Required Skills**

- Three to six years of experience working in technology domain to develop and rollout data or technology platforms for programs – out of which, at least three years of experience developing, implementing, and supporting CommCare development for large and complex programs.
- Experience in source code and version control platforms, for example, GitHub, Azure DevOps, or similar.
- Strong in team development processes including pair programming, shadow sessions, code reviews and other strategies to ensure high-quality programing.
- Strong code quality assurance practices including unit testing, integration testing, as well as regression testing to ensure quality of the code getting shipped into production.
- Working knowledge of agile software delivery practices (user stories, backlog grooming, sprint ceremonies) and a demonstrated preference for iterative, requirements-driven development.
- Ability to effectively communicate in English both in verbal (i.e., day-to-day discussions, team meetings) and written (requirements and design specifications) form, as well as an overall ability to be clear and concise in all communications. More specifically, the ability to clearly explain complex technology issues in layman’s terms and simplify tech-related language depending on the audience/stakeholders is a huge asset.
- Strong attention to detail to ensure fidelity to requirements and high-quality products.
- Strong analytic curiosity and innovative problem-solving skills using a system thinking approach.
- Demonstrable ability to work both independently and in a dynamic, cross-functional team structure.
- Demonstrable ability to establish and maintain working relationships across all departments and levels of the organization.

**Education:**

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related discipline
- Experience with Databricks, Dataverse connectors, APIs, and Microsoft Azure

**This is a remote position open to internal candidates based in countries where IRC operates who have the right to work in their location. Successful candidates will be hired on a local employment contract and according to local salary scale.**

**This role is open to candidates located and with the right to work in United Kingdom and Kenya.**

**Compensation:** (UK Pay Rate: £49,598 - £60,040/yr). Ranges are based on various factors including the labor market, job type, internal equity, and budget. Exact offers are calibrated by work location, individual candidate experience and skills relative to the defined job requirements.

**Equal Opportunity Employer:** IRC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. IRC considers all applicants on the basis of merit without regard to race, sex, color, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

**Professional Standards:** All International Rescue Committee workers must adhere to the core values and principles outlined in IRC Way - Standards for Professional Conduct. Our Standards are Integrity, Service, Equality and Accountability. In accordance with these values, the IRC operates and enforces policies on Safeguarding, Conflicts of Interest, Fiscal Integrity, and Reporting Wrongdoing and Protection from Retaliation. IRC is committed to take all necessary preventive measures and create an environment where people feel safe, and to take all necessary actions and corrective measures when harm occurs. IRC builds teams of professionals who promote critical reflection, power sharing, debate, and objectivity to deliver the best possible services to our clients.
